reason: I have run my practice smoothly on Excel and WhatsApp for ten years without exposing client data, so I will not pay for software connecting to our Google Drive until I verify it cannot see our confidential files.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: Verifying on the free pilot that Google OAuth strictly isolates Docketra to its own folder without any permission to access external firm files.
